title: Shenzhen, home to tech giants and an illicit trade of smuggled chips and stolen iPhones, is clearing out its illegitimate markets ahead of the APEC summit (William Langley/Financial Times)
summary: William Langley / Financial Times: Shenzhen, home to tech giants and an illicit trade of smuggled chips and stolen iPhones, is clearing out its illegitimate markets ahead of the APEC summit — Shenzhen clears out illicit markets for smuggled chips and stolen iPhones as it prepares to host gathering of international leaders
